# uibc-core

> uibc-core is a reference implementation of UIBC (Uniform Identity-Behavior
> Chain): verifiable evidence packages for AI agents, built on the LGD
> principles - Registry (有籍), Evidence (有证), Gates (有门禁).
> Status: PROPOSAL v0.2.x. Verification results are scoped proofs, not
> absolute trust claims.

Core idea: every AI agent action can be sealed into a submission.uibc
package (identity + lifecycle events + content-hashed evidence + Merkle
evidence root + optional HMAC seal), then verified offline by anyone:
`uibc verify pkg.uibc --key owner.key` exits 0 on PASS, 1 on FAIL.

What is verifiable today:
- Package structure, identity consistency (S1/S2)
- Lifecycle state machine L1-L7 with hash-chained events (S3)
- Evidence content hashes and Merkle root (S4/S5)
- Owner seal signature, strict/open modes (S6; HMAC-SHA256 v0.2, Ed25519 v0.3 target)
- Gate decisions ALLOW(0)/DENY(2)/HOLD(3) with revocation/dispute overlays
- Certificates binding a verified package (cert-issue / cert-verify)
- Memory migration verification: Fact/Attribution/Citation/Version Preservation
- Golden fixtures: 8 attack/mutation categories, cross-checked by two
  independent implementations (70 checks, 0 disagreements)

Key files:
- README.md - 5-minute quickstart, CLI reference
- docs/SPEC-PROPOSAL-v0.1.md - the spec (PROPOSAL)
- docs/governance.md - Dispute/Correction/Revocation/Accountability/Continuity/Provenance
- docs/api-scope.md - what is public (read-only) vs local (writes)
- docs/adoption-guide.md - minimal adoption path for a small team
- fixtures/EXPECTED.md - attack fixtures with expected-vs-observed
- independent_verifier/ - second, spec-derived implementation + cross-check

Known boundaries (recorded, not hidden):
- HMAC is symmetric: third-party verification needs Ed25519 (v0.3)
- Key substitution is detectable only with the owner key (out-of-band pinning)
- Evidence root algorithm is provisional pending canonical-JSON ratification
- Timestamps are not independently anchored
